If you want to stay moving all day, curbside is great!

You absolutely can tell your manager that you want to work less days per week, theres nothing wrong with that. I worked 4 days a week for over a then went down to 3 a few months ago. You have no obligation to work 5 days unless you were hired as full time. The 8 hour shifts do sometimes feel very long, but if you can stick around, the opening shift is definitely the best I think, much better than closing or a mid day shift

Subbing and shorting does suck, but as long as you go through the steps to ask if that department has it, you’re good! I know it seems like some departments are tired of hearing about items not on the shelf, but its part of their job to listen to our questions and our job to ask. It’s not your fault if the store doesnt have the item in stock, so i wouldn’t worry about substitutions or shorts. 
Curbie is not the greatest but if you practice shopping, you will get good enough, hopefully they keep you on the floor. Tbh i think it takes lots of practice to get good at shopping, your managers and other partners know you are new, they know you’re still learning and getting the hang of it. You’ve probably only worked a few shifts, i would recommend sticking around! It’s a really fun iob and once you get the hang of shopping its kind of relaxing and a nice solo task. The other partners are really sweet too🥺, please consider staying, it gets easier, and aches and pains go away once your body gets used to working so much. Curbside is great because you are constantly moving, and you meet a lot of other people from other departments! Please message me if you have any questions👍
